g.text: GALINI · L01 · SEC01 / Ferry spawn and departures
Named encounter section / exact neighboring layout + predicted opposing and follower positions / no compiled acceptance
DRY RAVINE / -6 m
L
F
O
S
Spatial prediction
The five-body ferry spawn separates into a near S1 ascent,
a Cooper/S2 approach and the Shore Toe commitment. M03
blocks a direct lower diagonal into S2; Net Street behind
it is 4 m deep. W01 may reveal a standing Net player
without revealing the bomb or Shore Toe.
Follower / support
A follower can remain below the S1 mouth or shift along
Net Street toward S2. Supporting an ascending leader is
height-dependent; do not infer a clear trade over the
crest wall.
Opponent / retreat
The W01 observer must approach the sill and turn away from
Press. A ground player can challenge the aperture or
crouch behind the lower crest; the whole spawn is not
assumed visible.
